description: Type text into an input field or currently focused element. If id/selector/label is omitted, automatically types directly into document.activeElement without needing a redundant click or browser_map. If target is already focused, skips click to prevent unfocus bugs.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

clearFirst.description: Wipe existing field content before typing.

id.description: Ref ID from browser_map (e.g. 'w:42'). If omitted, types directly into the currently focused element or single page input.

include_map.description: Set true to include a full updated page_map in the response. Default false.

intent.description: Semantic description of the field (e.g. 'search box', 'username field'). Checked against learned memory first.

label.description: Field label or placeholder text. Used for fuzzy matching.

paste.description: Instant paste mode via clipboard. Auto-enabled for text longer than 8 chars.

selector.description: CSS selector of the input field.

tab_id.description: Execute in a specific tab instead of active.

target.description: CSS selector or query string. Alias for selector.

text.description: Text to type into the field.

x.description: Raw X coordinate to focus before typing.

y.description: Raw Y coordinate to focus before typing.

name: browser_type
